|ingredients = {{Name|Solar Essence|5}}{{Name|Iron Bar|5}} |value = 100 |gprice = Not sold }} The '''Glowstone Ring''' is a [[Rings|ring]] that can be [[Crafting|crafted]] after earning the recipe at [[File:Mining Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Mining]] Level 4. It can also be purchased at the [[Stardew Valley Fair]] for {{Price|1000|Token}}, although it's not guaranteed to be in stock. It can also be found in [[Mystery Box]]es. Wearing it combines the lighting and [[magnetism]] effects of one [[Glow Ring]] and one [[Magnet Ring]]. Its effects stack with another Glowstone Ring, an [[Iridium Band]], a [[Glow Ring]], a [[Magnet Ring]], a [[Small Glow Ring]], or a [[Small Magnet Ring]]. ==Dyeing== The '''Glowstone Ring''' can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==History== {{History|1.5|Introduced.}} {{NavboxClothing}} [[Category:Rings]] [[Category:Craftable items]] [[de:Glühsteinring]] [[es:Anillo de piedras preciosas]] [[fr:Anneau de pierre luisante]] [[it:Anello di pietralucente]] [[ja:グロウストーンの指輪]] [[ko:발광석 반지]] [[hu:Világító kő gyűrű]] [[pt:Anel de Pedra Luminosa]] [[ru:Светокаменное кольцо]] [[tr:Işıktaşı Yüzüğü]] [[zh:辉石戒指]]
